descriptions.d15b_init_input_state_800a5fdc: Initialize an input/selection state in place: run the base initializer, install the original table pointer, clear a five-word range, set default limits (0, 0.5, step 0.25 and span 1 - 0.25), set packed mode bits, clear targets, cursor and origin, fill eight slots with -1, seek the slot level, publish the object as the current input state and clear the hold and repeat words. Partial observed layout; float constants are original read-only data referenced by address; no owned initialized data.
